name: com.rossogames.rossoforge-audio
description: A lightweight and data-driven audio management system for Rossoforge. Features decoupled audio channels and configuration-based audio sources

samples.description: Contains the core components required to initialize the pooled audio system. Includes the pre-configured PooledAudioHandler prefab and the PooledGameObjectData asset needed to associate the resource with the AudioServiceData.

A comprehensive demonstration scene that bootstraps the Audio Service. Features independent channel management (Music and SFX) with separate volume and mute controls, alongside a third transient sound that integrates with the object pool service to showcase short-lived audio playback.
